svg.title: Music streaming analytics architecture
svg.desc: Client posts play events to ingestion-service, which publishes to the play-events Kafka topic. Stream-processor consumes it, computes windowed aggregations, and writes results to two output topics. Query-service consumes those topics, writes to Redis, and serves a REST API back to the client. PostgreSQL is planned for week two.
svg.text: CQRS-style: writes flow through Kafka, reads served from Redis
